elements.name: Early morning bus station yard with soft gold light and long shadows
Single-file queue of men and women seen from behind
Queue running in a long curve across the yard
Small ticket window in a low building at the head of the queue
Young man with backpack, dark jacket and grey-green trousers as last in queue, nearest to us, seen from behind
Long-distance buses parked along one side

notes: Repaint the people as one clear single-file line that curves across the yard and ends at the ticket window, not as two side-by-side lines heading toward the buses. Remove the second near-identical backpacker so the young man on the right is the only last person. Blank out the scribbled text-like notice in the ticket window.
